stem.text: What is a correct statement about the movement of substances absorbed by roots?

A.text: Ions have to pass through cell walls to cross the endodermis.

B.text: Ions move through the symplastic pathway only until they reach the Casparian strip.

C.text: Soil water has a more negative water potential than the xylem sap.

D.text: Water passes through the symplastic pathway along a water potential gradient.
